name: Pacific Domes
use: Supplier-backed dome concepts after dimensions, scope, freight, and current quote are verified.
rules: Do not publish or promise a price from memory.
Store quote date, currency, model/configuration, inclusions, exclusions, freight terms, tax/import assumptions, and quote validity.
Supplier drawings do not replace local engineering, foundation design, permits, or regulated professional review.

name: Local foundation / site partner
use: Site preparation and foundation scope after survey, soil, drainage, and structural requirements are known.
rules: No allowance becomes a client commitment until scope is verified.
Use qualified local professionals for regulated work.

name: Local water, solar, landscape, and waste partners
use: Coordinate utilities and living systems around the approved property concept.
rules: Record vendor scope boundaries and dependencies.
Keep maintenance requirements visible in the offer.
